name: Sonic Ray
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray of sound
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause an invisible beam of sound to pummel the target. This spell deals 1d3 points of sonic damage upon making a successful ranged touch attack.
